_doc: worker_management#339 — a FINGERPRINT of fr's PLATFORM_TENANT_IDS at the pinned ref below, never the ids themselves (this repository is public). The hash is sha256 over the sorted, newline-joined canonical uuids. tests/test_platform_tenant_ids_drift.py compares WM's CONFIGURED set (PLATFORM_TENANT_IDS, gitops-supplied) against this fingerprint, and — when a checkout of fr is available — resolves fr's live source and compares that too. Re-copy the hash with a new fr ref whenever fr changes its set, and change WM's Deployment env in the same change.
hash_input: sorted canonical tenant uuids, joined with '\n'
